title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 93-96 (Hiranyaprakara, Samudratanaya, Jaya, Mangala Devi)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 93 to 96: Hiranyaprakara, Samudratanaya, Jaya, Mangala Devi, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 93 to 96 with meaning
caption: Names 93 to 96 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 93 to 96**: **Hiranyaprakara, Samudratanaya, Jaya, Mangala Devi**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Hiranyaprakara, Samudratanaya, Jaya, Mangala Devi.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Hiranyaprakara** means **Encircled by golden walls**. Sri Suktam: 'hiranyaprakaram', surrounded by golden walls.
**Samudratanaya** means **Daughter of the ocean**. That is why she is the ocean's daughter. Earlier she was the daughter of the sage Bhrigu and Khyati.
**Jaya** means **Victory**. Victory in right endeavour comes with her grace.
**Mangala Devi** means **The Auspicious Goddess**. The auspicious goddess; mangala also means welfare.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
